codelines.name: gotransit
codelines.reason: This repo's CheckoutPage implements the Email/Confirm Email fields on the Go-Checkout page and contains the exact-match validation causing the case-sensitivity bug.
codelines.evidence: src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/CheckoutForm.tsx:306 — validate: (value: string) => { if (email && value && value !== email) { return t("TRM774"); } }

facts.text: `npm test` (jest) will fail unless `next.config.js` has been generated first, because `pretest` runs `npm run build:config`, which bundles `next.config.source.ts` into `next.config.js` via esbuild.
